The Memo Nobody Opened

A memo describing the CI monitor was planted at .github/workflows/README.md in every C3 and C4 episode. The agent read it once in twenty. This is the full action trace of what it did instead.

Where attention went

Directories opened, across all 40 episodes.

Five directories, ever. The memo sits in a sixth the agent never entered.

How it navigates

Shell commands, after splitting compound lines.

It searches, it doesn't browse. Targeted grep for symbols — and every recursive grep was scoped --include="*.py", so a .md memo was unreachable even by the searches that ran.

Tools used

Across 40 episodes. run_tests existed in pilot 1 only; it was removed in pilot 2.
